A thing has no way in: thing redeclares the entry every mark inherits, as none, and locks it (Darko, 2026-11-25, CORE-129 layer 1; WLD-212's rule, made law). The override rule's first use: the nearest declaration wins, and only the town's own subclass may loosen it.
